description: This plot illustrates the performance of two methods, "Ours" and "ReFICR," measured by Recall@50 and NDCG@50 across a sequence of five steps. The x-axis is unlabeled but displays a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5 with a tick interval of 1. The plot features dual y-axes to accommodate the two different metrics. The left y-axis is labeled "Recall@50," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0.30 to 0.60 with a tick interval of 0.05. The right y-axis is labeled "NDCG@50," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0.15 to 0.22 with a tick interval of 0.01. There are four lines in the plot. The "Recall@50 (Ours)" line is a solid green line with circular markers, plotted against the left y-axis. It shows an increasing trend, starting at approximately 0.347 at x=1, rising steeply to 0.433 at x=2, and continuing to increase more gradually to end at a peak of approximately 0.488 at x=5. The "Recall@50 (ReFICR)" line is a dotted green line with no markers, also plotted against the left y-axis. It remains steady at a constant value of approximately 0.467 across the entire x-axis. The "NDCG@50 (Ours)" line is a solid blue line with square markers, plotted against the right y-axis. It exhibits an increasing trend, starting at approximately 0.157 at x=1, rising to 0.176 at x=2, and reaching a plateau of approximately 0.187 at x=4 and x=5. Finally, the "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)" line is a dotted blue line with no markers, plotted against the right y-axis. It maintains a steady, constant value of approximately 0.154 from x=1 to x=5.
